entities.summary: North Kosovo, also known as the Ibar Kolašin, earlier Old Kolašin, and colloquially known as the North, is a region in the northern part of Kosovo, generally understood as a group of four municipalities with ethnic Kosovo Serbs majority: North Mitrovica, Leposavić, Zvečan, and Zubin Potok.
